purpose: Judge that an effort, reputation, or expense was justified.
keywords: Plain clause / N + だけのことはある
Those three years of practice have paid off. The performance is steady.
These shoes justify their high price. They are comfortable to walk in.
The inn deserves its popularity. Its thoughtful touches are lovely.
formation: Plain clause / N + だけのことはある
restrictions: Usually confirms value after seeing the result.
mistake: Do not use it for an outcome that failed to meet expectations.
